record_identity.title: Provider-mediated dependence in external frontier-model evaluation

summary: METR's Frontier Risk Report documents an external-evaluation architecture that depends materially on voluntary provider participation, donated or provider-controlled model access and compute, provider review of non-public disclosures, bounded redaction rights and the possibility of silent withdrawal.
why_it_matters_to_CAM: The architecture can enable valuable independent scrutiny of otherwise inaccessible systems, but assurance claims remain conditioned by who controls access, publication timing, confidential disclosure, redaction and continuation. This is an observation about assurance architecture and evaluator dependence, not criticism of METR or an assertion that its findings are unreliable.
evidence_confidence: verified from evaluator's published methodology and disclosure terms

source_records.source_context: METR describes voluntary participation, free or donated model access and compute, provider review of non-public disclosures before publication, constrained redaction rights and the possibility that a participant may withdraw without public identification.
